description.source: Check reviewed claim costs and compare captured decisions with a portable receipt using local data.
description.text: 使用本地数据检查已审阅主张的成本，并通过便携凭证比较已捕获决策。

introduction.source: Measure the cost of claims you have reviewed, then compare the recorded buying terms with the receipt. Missing costs and ambiguous payment links stay visible.
introduction.text: 衡量您已审阅主张的成本，然后比较记录的购买条款与凭证。缺失成本和含糊的付款关联仍会显示。

decisionLabLink.source: Audit reviewed claim costs and compare decisions with receipts
decisionLabLink.text: 审计已审阅主张的成本，并比较决策与凭证

help.source: Paste a portable receipt with its review, cost records and captured decisions. Checking runs in this browser. Data stays in this tab until you clear it or leave. A downloaded result can contain private cost references.
help.text: 粘贴便携凭证及其审阅、成本记录和已捕获决策。检查在此浏览器运行。数据保留在此标签页，直到清除或离开。下载的结果可能包含私密成本参考。

trust.text: 单独留存的摘要 JSON（可选）

trustHelp.source: Use digests retained outside the supplied input to detect later changes. A matching digest alone cannot establish when a decision happened or prove that payment settled.
trustHelp.text: 使用在所提供输入之外留存的摘要检测后续更改。仅摘要匹配不能确定决策发生时间，也不能证明付款已结算。

refused.source: Audit unavailable. Check the JSON, receipt digest, exact evidence references and selected network.
refused.text: 审计不可用。请检查 JSON、凭证摘要、确切证据参考和所选网络。

supported.text: 所提供审阅中有支持的主张

sourceRatio.text: 每个有支持主张的来源成本（USDC）

providerRatio.source: LLM + search + other cost per supported claim (USD)
providerRatio.text: 每个有支持主张的 LLM + 搜索 + 其他成本（USD）

noDecisions.source: No captured decisions supplied. Historical records are not reconstructed.
noDecisions.text: 未提供已捕获决策。不会重建历史记录。

sourceTotals.source: Receipt-recorded settled access: ${access} micro-USDC. Citation rewards: ${citation} micro-USDC. Full source-cost window: ${window}.
sourceTotals.text: 凭证记录的已结算访问费：${access} micro-USDC。引用奖励：${citation} micro-USDC。完整来源成本窗口：${window}。

comparison.text: 访问：${access} · 引用：${citation} · 独立时间证明：${timing}

unmatched.source: Creator payments without an identity match: ${count}.
unmatched.text: 没有身份匹配的创作者付款：${count}。
